tei:bibl.tei:note: Converted from the export of opensiddur.org at 624215eef0.

tei:div.tei:p: This paraliturgical translation by Reb Zalman of Yitsḥaq Luria’s “Atqinu Seudata” for Friday evening can be found in print as published in his All Breathing Life: At the Interface Between Poetry and Prayer: translations and compositions of Jewish sacred literature (ed. Michael Kagan, 2011: Gaon Books), pp. 66-68. The signature acrostic presented in the original text is interrupted by a stanza added by Reb Zalman. If you have any more information about the addition of this stanza, please leave a comment or contact us.
